nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the project's design system: custom brand (blue-navy) and accent (teal) color palettes, soft box shadow, hero gradient background, and Inter font family applied across all app, component, and lib TypeScript source files.

nodes.name: vitest.config.mts
nodes.summary: Vitest test runner configuration enabling jsdom browser environment, React plugin support, TypeScript path alias resolution, and a 30-second test timeout with the thread pool executor.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses .mts extension (TypeScript ESM module) for native ESM import compatibility with Vitest's config loading.

nodes.name: vitest.setup.ts
nodes.summary: Global Vitest test setup that registers an afterEach hook to call React Testing Library's cleanup, preventing DOM leakage between tests in environments where RTL does not auto-detect Vitest's lifecycle hooks.

nodes.name: index.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone background worker process that polls the Next.js app's /api/jobs/worker endpoint on a configurable interval, atomically claiming and processing one background job per poll cycle, with graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown and immediate re-poll queue draining.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure ESM (.mjs) Node.js script using top-level await via async IIFE. Uses native fetch (Node 18+). No bundler or transpiler — runs directly with node.

nodes.name: poll
nodes.summary: Sends a single POST request to the worker job endpoint, handles 403 authentication failures with immediate exit, logs non-OK responses as retryable warnings, and returns true when a job was processed (signaling the caller to re-poll immediately) or false when idle.

nodes.name: loop
nodes.summary: Main polling loop that runs while the process is alive: calls poll() and either sleeps for POLL_MS on idle or immediately re-polls to drain the queue when a job was processed; exits cleanly when the running flag is cleared by a signal handler.
